newsitem.title: USA: Court hearing set on Conrail meeting.
newsitem.headline: Court hearing set on Conrail meeting.

text.p: U.S. District Court Judge Donald VanArtsdalen has scheduled a hearing for Tuesday on a request by Norfolk Southern Corp. to block any postponement of a key meeting by Conrail Inc. shareholders, a court official and a Norfolk Southern attorney said Monday.

At the Conrail meeting scheduled for Dec. 23, shareholders will be asked to waive a Pennsylvania law so that CSX Corp. can proceed with its plan to acquire Conrail in a cash-and-stock merger worth about $8.5 billion.
The law would effectively require CSX to pay all cash for Conrail if it was not waived.

Norfolk Southern, seeking to acquire Conrail with an all-cash bid of $10 billion, or $110 per share, has urged Conrail shareholders to reject the waiver at the meeting. Conrail has said it could postpone the meeting if it did not have the necessary votes to pass the waiver next week.
An influential shareholder advisory firm last week recommended voting against the waiver, but Conrail has given no indication the meeting will be postponed.
The hearing was set for at 11 a.m. EST.
